Porto.name: Francesco Farioli
Porto.tactics_ko: If the mid-block is bypassed his teams typically resort to a 5-3-2/5-4-1 low-block, prioritising compact structure and neutralising space in behind. Farioli's priority when arriving at clubs has been creating solid defensive foundations.

Benfica.name: Marco Silva

Benfica.tactics_ko: Silva tends to set his teams up in a 4-2-3-1 formation with an emphasis on progressive passing and wide positional rotations, notably the striker and number 10 swapping roles with both wingers joining the inside channels to create a tight attacking unit.
